title: Sweep
description: A sensitivity discovery sweep (docs/adr/0032-sensitivity-discovery-sweeps.md): how a car responds to one setting, learned from one experiment per step against the same baseline. It never changes the champion.

parameter.description: The setting swept: the item, or a linked group's leader.

baseline_version_id.description: The setup every step is measured against; it goes back on the car between steps.

requested.description: The steps asked for, in clicks from the baseline.

planned.description: The steps the sweep drives, in order, after clipping to the item's range.

skipped.description: What clipping changed or skipped, in words.

state.title: SweepState
state.description: running: a step is being driven or about to be. waiting: another experiment is on the car. done: every step measured and the curve classified. stopped: by the driver. failed: stopped by the sweep itself (an invalid step, an AI failure, the baseline moved); the message says why.

steps.description: The steps driven so far, oldest first.

finding_class.description: The verdict's finding on lap time (ADR 0029), once judged.
